camel_example: aliyun iot QueryStudioAppPageListOpen --region cn-hangzhou --AppId a120000000 --IotInstanceId 'iot_instc_pu0000_c0-v6400000000' --PageSize 20 --ProjectId a12000000 --IsRelease false --PageNo 1
description_en: Invoke this API to obtain the list of application pages.
description_zh: 调用该接口获取应用页面列表
kebab_example: aliyun iot query-studio-app-page-list-open --app-id a120000000 --iot-instance-id iot_instc_pu0000_c0-v6400000000 --is-release false --page-no 1 --page-size 20 --project-id a12000000 --api-version 2018-01-20 --region cn-hangzhou
name: QueryStudioAppPageListOpen

parameters.description_en: The application ID. You can invoke [QueryStudioAppList](~~216816~~) to query it.

parameters.name: app_id

parameters.description_en:
The instance ID.

<props="china">You can view the **ID** of the current instance on the **Instance Overview** page in the IoT Platform console. If an ID value exists, you must specify this ID; otherwise, the invocation will fail.</props>

<props="china">
> If the public instance does not have an ID value, see [How to Obtain an Instance ID](~~267533~~).</props>
parameters.description_zh:
实例ID。

<props="china">您可在物联网平台控制台的**实例概览**页面，查看当前实例的**ID**。若有ID值，必须传入该ID值，否则调用会失败。</props>

<props="china">
> 如果公共实例没有ID值，请参见[如何获取实例ID](~~267533~~)。</props>

parameters.description_en:
Specifies whether to retrieve application pages.  
- **true**: Retrieves published application pages.  
- **false (default)**: Retrieves unpublished application pages.
parameters.description_zh:
获取应用页面。
- **true**：获取已发布的应用页面。
- **false（默认）**：获取未发布的应用页面。

parameters.name: page_size

parameters.description_en:
The project ID.  
1. Log on to the [IoT application development console](https://account.aliyun.com/login/login.htm?qrCodeFirst=false&oauth_callback=https%3A%2F%2Fstudio.iot.aliyun.com%2F%3Fspm%3Da2c4g.11186623.2.8.1e7830fagdybMb). After selecting the corresponding instance in the upper-left corner of the page, click Project Management in the left-side navigation pane.  
2. In the standard project list, locate the target project, click the project card, and then check the address bar of your browser.
parameters.description_zh:
项目ID。
1.您可登录[物联网应用开发控制台](https://account.aliyun.com/login/login.htm?qrCodeFirst=false&oauth_callback=https%3A%2F%2Fstudio.iot.aliyun.com%2F%3Fspm%3Da2c4g.11186623.2.8.1e7830fagdybMb)，在页面左上角选择对应实例后，在左侧导航栏单击项目管理。
2. 在普通项目列表中，找到目标项目，单击项目卡片，在地址栏中查看。
